name: Spanish
notes: Around 500 million native speakers across Spain and most of the Americas. Spelling is almost perfectly phonetic — once you learn the five vowel sounds you can pronounce any written word correctly, which makes it one of the fastest languages for an English speaker to become useful in.
syllabus: About 590 words, including 100 verbs — all of CEFR A1 and the start of A2: the three past tenses (guide and deck), daily routines, illness, weather, feelings and the connectors for telling a story. A2 is around 1,000 words; this is a quarter of the way through it. Cards can be spoken aloud if Windows has a Spanish voice installed.
